title: Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening — application of 91 researched scoped methods
purpose: A bounded application sanity check on this poem, not a new breadth search or a claim that all 415 inventory names have validated detectors.

state_definitions.observed: A stated method or explicitly identified adaptation was applied and a qualifying occurrence was recorded.
state_definitions.checked_no_match: The declared bounded check was completed without a qualifying match; not a universal absence claim.
state_definitions.interpretation_or_component_only: A partial computation, candidate or contextual reading is available but the qualifying verified method was not fully applied.
state_definitions.out_of_scope: The verified method requires an input domain or construction not supplied by this poem.
state_definitions.not_executed: The method was not applied; no positive or negative claim follows.

counting_rules: One row is one inventory entry; several labels may describe the same passage or repetition event.
Observed means observed under the stated method, adaptation and scope; it is not independent validation of an automatic detector.
Checked_no_match is only the bounded check stated in that row, not universal absence of the device.
Interpretation_or_component_only includes incomplete algorithms, useful components and optional contextual readings; it is not a complete method success.
Out_of_scope excludes a source method's declared domain or construction, not the broader literary device from the poem.
Not_executed does not entail absence; local screening or a retained old annotation is not execution of the researched method.
Manual review means assistant application of documented human decision instructions, with no independent human agreement measurement.
Grouped finding cards may contain additional close-reading labels outside the 91 methods; those labels do not change these counts.
Dictionary-alternative sound results are conditional on dictionary pronunciations and do not establish contextual validity of every pronunciation.
